_doc: HOENN_VERSION=emerald (emerald_world 2026-10-12, notes/EMERALD.md "Emerald's world"): the Emerald-only outdoor maps (the groups' maps of data/emerald/hoenn_standalone.json that data/hoenn_zones.json lacks) -> data/emerald/hoenn_zones.json, deep-merged over data/hoenn_zones.json by the Emerald world's readers (version.load_json). Every other map keeps Sapphire's zone (rooms' exits, scripts and savestates name them), and data/hoenn_zones.json is never written here. An Emerald-only map shares the zone of the map it connects to in its group (pokeemerald connections, the first one that has a zone): the Safari Zone's expansion areas are their west neighbours' zones, the Battle Frontier's east half is the island's zone 17. A zone of its own needs its scripts, wild table, music and place in the ROM (phases 1/3, notes/EMERALD.md work list), so none is given out yet.
